authorization: one Authorization Bearer header; current access token only
content_type: one application/json header; optional single plain charset=utf-8 only; no duplicates, extensions or empty parameters
json_validation: exact object; no unknown, duplicate, escaped-equivalent, missing, null, case-aliased, mistyped, invalid UTF-8 or trailing fields; integer revision has canonical decimal encoding
session_authority: unexpired token and exact unrevoked session binding
session_lookup_encoding: existing Auth rt:<canonical sid> in RefreshTokenHash; no hashing or storage migration introduced
persistence_log_policy: private silent GORM session for this boundary only; base database logger unchanged; no session key or driver diagnostic logging
admin_authority: fresh authenticated exact canonical-default Admin confirmation, followed by revalidation of the same current session
issuance_authority: existing AUTH_RBAC_MENTOR_ROLE_DECISION_V1 issuer with the same strict session verifier and authenticated owner confirmations
client_obligations: independent proof signature and exact command binding verification
runtime_registration_semantics: default; explicit AUTH_MENTOR_ENABLED opt-in mounts only dedicated HTTPS, never plaintext Echo
runtime_owner_requester: separate mandatory authenticated verified-TLS NATS connection; bounded credentials snapshot; no anonymous/plaintext/reconnect/fallback
